From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-25T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood pilot — call recap & proposed next steps

Hi Lina,

Appreciate you making time earlier — quick recap and a proposed, minimal next-step to keep momentum: 

Call recap (10/25):
- Goal: validate Redwood inference across Orchard’s patient messaging workload (low-latency, PII handling).
- Key constraints: SSO + SCIM, data retention rules, and preferring an on-cloud dedicated pool for predictable latency.
- Success metric: end-to-end 99th perc token latency < 150ms for canonical flows + no PII persisted beyond 30 days.

Proposed next steps (minimal pilot):
1) Pilot scope: 2-week PoC using a single integration path (inbound patient message rerank -> suggestion pipeline). We provide a sandbox model and a small GPU-backed endpoint.
2) Tech checklist: share SOC2 evidence, SSO test account, and sample anonymized payloads.
3) Commercial: ballpark pilot credits + short-term pricing sheet (see attached redwood-pilot-pricing.xlsx).
4) Timeline: target start week of 11/8, wrap by 11/22.

Attachments: PoC-scope-Redwood-v1.pdf (scope), redwood-pilot-pricing.xlsx (ballpark).

As a low-effort option, we can also run a 7-day lightweight eval with a hosted dev key if you want to avoid ops overhead. If this still looks useful, can you confirm: (a) IT/engineering owner to loop in for SSO, (b) preferred start week, (c) any non-negotiable compliance asks?

If it’s easier, I can send a 15-min calendar to lock next steps.

Thanks — looking forward.

Jonas
